name: Ambiguity Inhibitor

shapes: triggered:turnStarted (eventPlayerIs controller) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {owner:self,zone:hand} count 1 optional} -> if(targetExists) moveCard deck bottom; draw 1

notes: 'if you do' -> the draw is gated on a card actually being bottomed.

name: Ectypal Stave

shapes: activated COUNTERFEIT: condition numberCompare(deploysThisTurn{cardType:'tactic'}, '>=', 1); costs [payResources {add [2, {cardCost {lastDeployedTactic}}]}, deplete source]; effects: duplicate {lastDeployedTactic}

notes: Same lastDeployedTactic + duplicate shape as Voidal Replication; X = the tactic's printed cost.

shapes: keyword covert
triggered:characterAttacked (sourceIsEventCard) -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {type:character} count 1 optional} -> if(targetExists) moveCard hand

name: Land Shark

shapes: keyword covert
continuous self: strength +{count {owner:opponent, type:resource, faceDown:true}}, life +{same}

notes: 'face-down resource each opponent controls' = faceDown:true selector; in 2p one opponent.

name: Pervasive Bodyguard

shapes: activated PROTECT: costs [payResources 1], targets [{c:{type:character, conditions:[{sharesBattlePartyWithSource:{target:__candidate}}]} count 1}] -> createModifier {selected c} life +1 EOT

notes: 'a character in a party with this card' = sharesBattlePartyWithSource.

name: Recapitulating Apparition

shapes: triggered:cardMoved (and[sourceIsEventCard, cardMovedFromZone:'play', cardMovedToZone:'discard']) -> mayPay {player:controller, costs:[payResources 1], effects:[putIntoPlay {target:source, controller:controller}, deplete source], elseEffects:[]}

notes: 'put into your discard from play' -> cardMoved from play to discard. Self-recur via putIntoPlay(source) then deplete.

name: Resurrection Emporium

shapes: replacement {replaces:{event:'moveToZone', zone:'discard', cardType:'character', controlledBy:'self'}, effects:[removeFromGame {selected __candidate}]}

activated RESURRECT: condition {isActivePlayer:controller}; targets [{c:{owner:self, zone:discard, type:character} count 1}]; costs [payResources {add [3, {cardCost {selected c}}]}]; effects: putIntoPlay {selected c} {controller:controller}

notes: CONCESSION: the discard replacement only fires for a character leaving PLAY (applyReplacement's from==='play' guard) — a character milled straight from deck to discard is not caught. The common case (deaths) is covered. RESURRECT is functionally inert while clause 1 is active (the card's own tension), authored faithfully.

name: Samuel Gristwalter

shapes: continuous {damageModifiers:[{selector:{type:faction, controller:self}, delta:0, minAmount:1, setTo:0}]}

notes: Like Hypnotic Plafond but ALL damage (not battleOnly) and unconditional.

name: A Series of Tubes

shapes: activated REDIRECT: targets [{c:{type:character, subtype:'node'} count 1}] -> preventDamage {target:{selected c}, amount:1, mode:'redirect', redirectTo:source}
continuous aura {selector:{type:character, subtype:'node', conditions:[{not:{isCard:{target:source}}}]}, modifiers strength +1, life +1}
triggered:cardEnteredPlay (sourceIsEventCard) -> optional deck search {subtype:'node'} -> moveCard hand + shuffleDeck
triggered:cardDestroyed (sourceIsEventCard) -> forEach {subtype:'node', not isCard source} -> destroy

notes: Node cycle (Basic/Hub Node) + a preventDamage redirect + a node aura.

name: Makeshift Contrivance

shapes: activated DEPLOY: costs [payResources 1, deplete source] -> chooserSelectsTarget{chooser:controller, {owner:self, zone:hand} count 1 optional} -> playResource {target:{selected}, faceDown:'auto', player:controller}

notes: 'Play a resource' = pick a hand card, play it as a resource (auto face-up if a real resource).

name: Spiky Atlasphere

shapes: attachTo character
continuous {target:{attachedTo}, modifiers strength +1}
continuous {partyRestriction:{role:'attacking', minMembers:1, maxMembers:1, scope:'attachedParty'}}

triggered:attackerBlocked (and[{eventCardIs:{target:{attachedTo}}}]) -> forEach {blocking party} destroy; transformBattleDamage {target:{attachedTo}, role:'dealer', kind:'setAmount', amount:0, duration:EOT}

notes: partyRestriction gains scope:'attachedParty' (a party including the source's host). 'If you do, reduce battle damage to 0' -> the destroy always succeeds when there is a blocking party, so the setAmount rider is unconditional.

name: Subversion Matrix

shapes: attachTo character
continuous {suppressAllAbilities:{target:{attachedTo}}}
activated MOVE: costs [payResources 2], targets [{c:{type:character} count 1}] -> attachTo source {selected c}

notes: 'no rules text (incl. abilities)' = suppressAllAbilities on the host (Mittens of Muffled Thought pattern).

name: Topplemajig

shapes: continuous {condition:{inBattle:{target:source}}, modifiers:[{selector:{type:character, conditions:[{inBattle:{target:__candidate}}, {not:{sharesBattlePartyWithSource:{target:__candidate}}}]}, stat:speed, op:add, value:-1}]}

notes: Live conditional aura (gated on source being in a battle); opposing-party selector via inBattle + not-shares-source-party. Passive form of Jumping Screamspider's SCREAM.

name: Carnival King

shapes: activated CONGA LINE: costs [payResources 3, deplete source], targets [{c:{type:character, conditions:[{not:{inBattle:{target:__candidate}}}]} count 1}] -> forEach {type:character} grantRestriction mustBlock EOT; restrictParty {target:{selected c}, role:'attacking', minMembers:1, maxMembers:1, duration:EOT}

notes: CONCESSION: 'all characters able to block THE CHARACTER must do so' modelled as granting mustBlock to every character this turn (over-broad — they must block any attack, not just the picked one). The 'solo attacking party' clause is the new restrictParty effect.

shapes: continuous {condition:numberCompare(count{controller:opponent, type:character}, '>=', 4), keywords:[{target:source, keyword:'cannotBeBlocked'}]}

name: Bask Bomb

shapes: activated body: condition and(battleRole:'attacker', numberCompare({battlePartySize side:'blocking'}, '>=', 1)); targets [{c:{controller:self, conditions:[{inBattle:{target:__candidate, role:'attacker'}}]} count 1}, {bl:{conditions:[{inBattle:{target:__candidate, role:'blocker'}}]} count {battlePartySize side:'blocking'}}, {at:{conditions:[{inBattle:{target:__candidate, role:'attacker'}}]} count {battlePartySize side:'attacking'}}]; effects: bind x = {multiply [{stat {selected c} strength}, 2]}; bind y = {stat {selected c} strength}; destroy {selected c}; distributeAmong {chooser:controller, selected:'bl', amount:{variable x}}; distributeAmong {chooser:opponent, selected:'at', amount:{variable y}}

notes: Two distributeAmong steps with different choosers (controller for the blocking party, opponent for the attacking party). Mandatory party target counts == party size auto-select the whole party.

shapes: activated FIREBREATHING: variables {x}, variableBounds x >=0, costs [payResources {multiply [{variable x}, 2]}, deplete source], targets [{c:{type:character} count 1}] -> dealDamage {selected c} {variable x}
triggered:attackerBlocked (sourceIsEventCard) -> forEach {selector:{type:character, conditions:[{inBattle:{target:__candidate, role:'blocker'}}]}} -> dealDamage __candidate 1
